Job Purpose :

This role represents a high-profile mandate within the organization, ICT & Services Product Growth Specialist drives revenue growth for the company's ICT hardware and software portfolio. The role owns the product's go-to-market execution, manages commercial relationships with principals and distributors, supports sales with proposals, and tracks revenue performance per product segment for management reporting.

The role leads and manages ICT & Services revenue growth enablement by taking full accountability for shaping GTM propositions and ensuring investment business realization across the ICT & Services portfolio. Acting as the product owner, the role influences strategic decisions on product direction, monetization priorities, and pricing strategy ensuring strong alignment between market demand, network capabilities, and financial objectives in Enterprise B2B market.

Delivers direct and measurable impact on enterprise revenue growth, project win rates, GTM effectiveness, and portfolio profitability. Improves Assets investment returns through, optimized asset utilization, revenue boost program and cost efficiency initiatives. Strengthens the sustainability and competitiveness of the ICT & Services business by accelerating time-to-market, enhancing value propositions, and ensuring long-term monetization of network assets in support of Enterprise Business growth objectives.

Education : Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or Information Technology

Experience : Min. 3 - 6 years of experience in ICT & Services product engagement, marketing, or related roles.

Permanent (P)

Job Purpose :
To manage and optimize the performance of sales promotors across channels by ensuring effective deployment, capability development, performance tracking, and productivity monitoring to drive sales growth, product visibility, and customer advocacy

Main Responsibilities :
1. Determining the optimal headcount of promotors for each region and retail outlet based on foot traffic and sales potential.
2. Monitoring daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets for the promotor force, identifying underperformers for coaching or reallocation.
3. Ensure promotors are equipped with selling skills, customer engagement techniques, and brand knowledge.
4. Ensure promotors execute advocacy process, sales campaigns, new product offering, and merchandising standards
5. Maintaining the relationship with third-party manpower agencies to ensure quality recruitments

Contract

wo-jpfa-JR5742.d:
Job Description :

1. Oversee daily hatchery operations to ensure efficiency and productivity.

2. Manage unit Profit & Loss (P&L), including revenue, costs, and profitability.

3. Optimize production capacity, resources, and operational costs.

4. Drive business growth and achieve production and financial targets.

5. Ensure product quality, regulatory compliance, and team performance.

Requirements :

1. Minimum Diploma (D3/D4) and Bachelor (S1) of Fisheries / Aquaculture

2. Minimum of 3 - 5 years of being Manager / Head of Unit in Fish Hatcheries

3. Understands the entire fish hatchery process

4. Has strong strategic thinking, analytical, interpersonal, time management, organizational, and leadership skills

5. Experienced in budget planning, margin control, and exposure to Profit & Loss (P&L) statements

Deskripsi Pekerjaan :

1. Mengawasi kegiatan operasional pembenihan ikan sehari-hari untuk memastikan efisiensi dan produktivitas berjalan optimal.

2. Mengelola Profit & Loss (P&L) unit kerja, termasuk pendapatan, biaya operasional, dan profitabilitas.

3. Mengoptimalkan kapasitas produksi, pemanfaatan sumber daya, serta biaya operasional.

4. Mendorong pertumbuhan bisnis serta memastikan pencapaian target produksi dan keuangan.

5. Memastikan kualitas produk, kepatuhan terhadap regulasi, serta kinerja tim berjalan sesuai standar yang ditetapkan.

Kualifikasi :

1. Minimal Diploma (D3/D4) dan Sarjana (S1) Perikanan / Akuakultur

2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3–5 tahun sebagai Manager atau Head of Unit di bidang pembenihan ikan (Fish Hatchery).

3. Memahami keseluruhan proses dan tahapan operasional pembenihan ikan.

4. Memiliki kemampuan berpikir strategis, analitis, interpersonal, manajemen waktu, organisasi, serta kepemimpinan yang baik.

5. Berpengalaman dalam perencanaan anggaran, pengendalian margin keuntungan, serta memahami laporan keuangan Profit & Loss (P&L).

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
